title: 第82章 恐怖逆天的尸阴诀第81章 彼此僵持的陆成和青璇
slug: 凡人修仙我让高冷女宗主孕气十足
content_zh:
第82章恐怖逆天的尸阴诀！
陆成淡然的一句话响彻在宫殿内。
他目光紧紧望着锁链的底部。
锁链底部，刻着复杂难懂的黑色阵法。
根据这两个月的经历，陆成发现，只要青璇试图挣脱锁链，
那复杂的黑色阵法便会涌出黑色光线，通过锁链，涌入青璇的身体。
而这黑色光线仿佛对青璇身体造成极大的伤害。
每一次，青璇脸上表情都是极其痛苦，身躯不自主剧烈颤抖。
而造成这一切的根源，一是贯穿她体内的锁链，二是那阵法涌出的黑色光线。
陆成望向手中掌天鼎，不断推演。
青璇听到陆成的话微微一愣，睁开美目，一脸不可置信的望向陆成，冷笑道：“怎么，你想通了，想交出掌天鼎了？”
说着，又沉默刹那，嘴角勾起一丝冰冷的笑容道：“死人才是保守秘密最好的手段，你若不想死，也不是不可以，拜我为师，做我的尸傀！”
陆成嘴角微微一抽。
他猛地转身，看向青璇的眼神充满怒色，低沉道：“哎，我说你这女人也太狠心了吧？我好歹可以让你提前脱离此地，你就是这么对待恩人的？还拜你为师，然后被你炼出尸傀，那跟傀儡有什么区别？”
青璇美目注视着陆成，讥讽道：“你在胡说什么，你死后，掌天鼎依旧会落在我的手中！”
说着，又道：“我之前就说过，你根本不可能突破筑基巅峰之后的境界，你只不过是徒劳罢了！况且，成为我的傀儡，可是你这辈子的福气，万年前，可是要很多筑基小儿，求着当我的尸傀，我懒都懒得看他们一眼！”
陆成嘴角再次一僵，不可否认，化神境，恐怕是大周王朝内，数百年乃至数千年难以见到的存在。
现在的大周王朝，最强者，也不过是金丹境强者而已。
但是他不懂，为何还有人想着主动去尸阴宗当一个尸傀，那跟自寻死路有什么区别？
陆成冷声道：“少在这里说大话，你这话，也就唬唬别人还行，在这装什么？还有人求着当你的尸傀，那根本不可能，成为你们尸阴宗的尸傀，简直跟死人没啥区别，你让我相信那些人，难不成愚蠢的主动去你尸阴宗寻死？呵……”

青璇美目看着陆成，讥讽道：“小子，你不懂我尸阴宗，到底有多强，只是现在的你，太过于弱小罢了，若是万年前，哪怕你是天灵根，都没有拜入我尸阴宗的资格！”
天灵根都没有拜入尸阴宗的资格？
陆成微微一愣，心中泛起滔天巨浪！
若她如此说，那尸阴宗也实在太过目中无人了！
天灵根便是天地的宠儿，体内只有一种灵根，这种修士，修炼速度极快。
他们感悟天地灵气的速度，要远远超越于真灵根和杂灵根修士数倍。
而这种天赋的妖孽者，竟然还没有踏入尸阴宗的资格？
青璇看着陆成愣在原地，冷笑道：“谁说成为我尸阴宗的尸傀，就会彻底死亡了？”
陆成询问道：“难道不会死？那我步入这死亡禁地后，遇见的那些死尸是怎么回事？”
“那是她们自愿的而已！”她说。
他们自愿的？
自愿而死？
陆成眼神再次怪异起来。
青璇美目看向前方宫殿大门，仿佛视线可以穿透宫殿之外，看见尸阴宗遗址内的一切，淡然道：
content_en:
Chapter 82 The terrifying Corpse Yin Art!
Lu Cheng's indifferent words echoed throughout the palace.
He stared hard at the bottom of the chain.
The bottom of the chain is engraved with complex and incomprehensible black formations.
Based on the experience of these two months, Lu Cheng discovered that as long as Qingxuan tried to break free from the chains,
The complex black formation will pour out black light, pouring into Qingxuan's body through the chains.
And this black light seemed to cause great harm to Qingxuan's body.
Every time, Qingxuan's face showed extreme pain, and her body shook violently involuntarily.
The root causes of all this are, firstly, the chains running through her body, and secondly, the black light gushing out from that formation.
Lu Cheng looked at the heavenly cauldron in his hand and continued to deduce.
Qingxuan was slightly startled when she heard Lu Cheng's words, opened her beautiful eyes, looked at Lu Cheng in disbelief, and sneered: "What, you have figured it out and want to hand over the Zhangtian Cauldron?"
After saying that, he remained silent for a moment, then a cold smile appeared at the corner of his mouth and said: "Dead people are the best way to keep secrets. If you don't want to die, it's not impossible. You can worship me as your teacher and be my corpse puppet!"
Lu Cheng's mouth twitched slightly.
He turned around suddenly, looked at Qingxuan with eyes full of anger, and said in a low voice: "Hey, I think you are too cruel as a woman, right? I can let you leave this place early. Is this how you treat your benefactor? I worship you as your teacher, and then you make a corpse puppet. What's the difference between that and a puppet?"
Qingxuan looked at Lu Cheng with her beautiful eyes and said sarcastically: "What are you talking about? After you die, the Heavenly Palm Cauldron will still fall into my hands!"
Then he added: "I have said before that it is impossible for you to break through the realm after the peak of Foundation Establishment. You are just trying in vain! Besides, becoming my puppet is your blessing in this life. Thousands of years ago, there were many Foundation Establishment children begging to be my corpse puppets, and I didn't even bother to look at them!"
The corner of Lu Cheng's mouth froze again. It was undeniable that the state of transformation into gods was probably something that would be difficult to see in the Zhou Dynasty for hundreds or even thousands of years.
The strongest people in the current Great Zhou Dynasty are only those in the Golden Core realm.
But he doesn't understand why there are still people who want to take the initiative to become a corpse puppet in the Corpse Yin Sect. What's the difference between that and seeking death?
Lu Cheng said coldly: "Stop talking big words here. What you are saying is just to bluff others. What are you pretending to do here? There are still people asking to be your corpse puppet. That is impossible. Becoming a corpse puppet of your Corpse Yin Sect is no different from a dead person. You want me to believe those people. Could it be that they are stupid and take the initiative to seek death in your Corpse Yin Sect? Ha..."
Qingxuan looked at Lu Cheng with her beautiful eyes and said sarcastically: "Boy, you don't understand how strong our Corpse Yin Sect is. It's just that you are too weak now. If it were ten thousand years ago, even if you had Tianlinggen, you wouldn't have the qualifications to join our Corpse Yin Sect!"
Even Tianlinggen is not qualified to join the Corpse Yin Sect?
Lu Cheng was slightly startled, and a huge wave surged in his heart!
If she said this, then the Corpse Yin Sect is really too arrogant!
Tianlinggen is the darling of heaven and earth. There is only one kind of spiritual root in the body. This kind of monk can practice extremely fast.
The speed at which they can perceive the spiritual energy of heaven and earth is far superior to that of True Spiritual Root and Miscellaneous Spiritual Root monks by several times.
And a monster with such talent is not yet qualified to enter the Corpse Yin Sect?
Qingxuan looked at Lu Cheng and sneered, "Who said that becoming a corpse puppet of my Corpse Yin Sect will lead to complete death?"
Lu Cheng asked: "Isn't it possible to die? Then what happened to the dead bodies I met when I entered this forbidden land of death?"
"That's all of their own free will!" she said.
Did they do it voluntarily?
Die voluntarily?
Lu Cheng's eyes became strange again.
Qingxuan's beautiful eyes looked towards the palace gate in front, as if her sight could penetrate beyond the palace and see everything in the ruins of the Corpse Yin Sect, and said calmly:
